title: Oh Brother, This Guy Stinks!
blurb: No appeal, no deliberation, no mitigating factors entered into evidence. The man simply stinks. The delivery carries pure jury-duty exasperation, the voice of somebody who has watched enough and would now like to say so publicly. That total absence of diplomacy is how it became the internet's favourite instant verdict. Play it when anybody underperforms in front of witnesses — a game lobby, a cooking attempt, a karaoke choice made with far too much confidence. The people have spoken and the ruling stands. There will be no further correspondence.
origin: A viral reaction clip adopted as the internet's harshest instant review.
